commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: design
commands.description: Grant or revoke Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: design-sync
commands.description: Push a React design system to claude.ai/design. This runs a converter that bundles the real component code (from Storybook or a bare package) and uploads it. Use when the user runs /design-sync or says "sync my design system to Claude Design".

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

server:
  use-forward-headers: true

# 결제 도메인 관련 설정 추가
payment:
  encryption:
    # 개발/테스트 환경용 하드코딩 암호화 키 (실제 운영 환경에서는 환경변수로 교체 필요)

    max-count: 5 # 사용자당 최대 등록 가능한 카드 정보 수
  retry:
    max-attempts: 3 # 결제 실패 시 최대 재시도 횟수
    delay-ms: 1000 # 재시도 간격 (밀리초)
  logging:
    mask-sensitive-data: true # 민감 정보 마스킹 활성화 여부

    timeout: 10000 # 외부 API 호출 타임아웃 (밀리초)
  # Kafka 결제 처리 관련 설정
  kafka:
    enabled: true  # Kafka 결제 처리 활성화 여부
    topics:
      processing: "payment-processing-topic"
      retry: "payment-retry-topic"
    consumer:
      processing-group: "payment-processing-group"
      retry-group: "payment-retry-group"
      concurrency: 1  # 동시 처리 수 (결제는 순차 처리 권장)
    producer:
      timeout-ms: 5000
    retry:
      max-attempts: 3
      backoff-multiplier: 2
      initial-delay-ms: 1000

# weather 도메인 설정
weather:
  api:
    url: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast
    params:
      latitude: 36.5
      longitude: 127.75
      hourly: temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,precipitation,rain,snowfall
      timezone: auto
  scheduler:
    # 24시간(86400000 밀리초) 간격으로 갱신
    interval: 86400000
    # 초기 지연 시간 (서버 시작 후 10초 대기)
    initial-delay: 10000
  data:
    # 한 번에 처리할 시간 개수 (48시간)
    hours-count: 48

# AccessLog 도메인 설정
access-log:
  use-kafka: false  # false로 설정하여 직접 DB에 저장
  geoip:
    database-path: classpath:GeoLite2-City.mmdb
  kafka:
    topic: user-access-log-topic
    group-id: user-access-log-group

content.content:
card-info:
    max-count: 5 # 사용자당 최대 등록 가능한 카드 정보 수
  retry:
    max-attempts: 3 # 결제 실패 시 최대 재시도 횟수
    delay-ms: 1000 # 재시도 간격 (밀리초)
  logging:
    mask-sensitive-data: true # 민감 정보 마스킹 활성화 여부
  api:
    timeout: 10000 # 외부 API 호출 타임아웃 (밀리초)
  # Kafka 결제 처리 관련 설정
  kafka:
    enabled: true  # Kafka 결제 처리 활성화 여부
    topics:
      processing: "payment-processing-topic"
      retry: "payment-retry-topic"
    consumer:
      processing-group: "payment-processing-group"
      retry-group: "payment-retry-group"
      concurrency: 1  # 동시 처리 수 (결제는 순차 처리 권장)
    producer:
      timeout-ms: 5000
    retry:
      max-attempts: 3
      backoff-multiplier: 2
      initial-delay-ms: 1000

# weather 도메인 설정
weather:
  api:
    url: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast
    params:
      latitude: 36.5
      longitude: 127.75
      hourly: temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,precipitation,rain,snowfall
      timezone: auto
  scheduler:
    # 24시간(86400000 밀리초) 간격으로 갱신
    interval: 86400000
    # 초기 지연 시간 (서버 시작 후 10초 대기)
    initial-delay: 10000
  data:
    # 한 번에 처리할 시간 개수 (48시간)
    hours-count: 48

# AccessLog 도메인 설정
access-log:
  use-kafka: false  # false로 설정하여 직접 DB에 저장
  geoip:
    database-path: classpath:GeoLite2-City.mmdb
  kafka:
    topic: user-access-log-topic
    group-id: user-access-log-groupsrc/main/resources/application.yml:6:  servlet:

spring:
  # 기본 프로필을 local로 활성화 (원하면 주석 처리하고, 실행 시 -Dspring.profiles.active=local 로 설정해도 됨)
  profiles:
    active: prod
  # 공통으로 사용하는 설정들
  servlet:
    multipart:
      max-file-size: 1GB
      max-request-size: 1GB
  data:
    web:
      pageable:
        default-page-size: 10
        max-page-size: 2000
        one-indexed-parameters: true
logging:
  level:
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    # org.hibernate.type: trace  # 필요시 주석 해제

# JWT 토큰 만료시간이나 공통 설정은 여기 둘 수 있음
jwt:
  expiration: 3600000      # (예시) 1시간
  refreshExpiration: 3600000

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: "*"======
spring:
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/freamdb?serverTimezone=UTC
    driver-class-name: <REDACTED>
    username: ${DB_USERNAME}
    password: <REDACTED>
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: create  # 운영환경은 보통 직접 DDL 관리
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true
  redis:
    host: redis
    port: 6379
    # password: <REDACTED>
  mail:
    host: smtp.gmail.com
    port: 587
    username: ${MAIL_USERNAME}
    password: <REDACTED>
    protocol: smtp
    properties:
      mail:
        smtp:
          auth: true
          starttls:
            enable: true
          ssl:
            trust: smtp.gmail.com
  kafka:
    bootstrap-servers: kafka:9092
    producer:
      acks: all  # 결제 안정성을 위한 설정
      retries: 3
      enable-idempotence: true  # 멱등성 보장
      batch-size: 16384
      linger-ms: 5
      buffer-memory: 33554432
    consumer:
      group-id: "my-group"  # 기본 그룹 (기존 ViewEvent용)
      auto-offset-reset: "earliest"
      enable-auto-commit: false  # 수동 커밋 (결제 처리 확실성)
      max-poll-records: 10
      fetch-min-size: 1024
      fetch-max-wait: 500
    # 결제 관련 추가 설정
    # 🚀 Order 처리 관련 Kafka 설정 (수정된 부분)
    order:
      consumer:
        processing-group: "order-processing-group"    # 주문 처리 그룹
        retry-group: "order-retry-group"              # 주문 재시도 그룹
        notification-group: "order-notification-group" # 주문 알림 그룹
      topics:
        processing: "order-processing-topic"          # 주문 처리 토픽
        retry: "order-retry-topic"                    # 주문 재시도 토픽
        notification: "notification-topic"            # 알림 토픽
      retry:
        max-attempts: 3
        backoff-delay-ms: 1000
      processing:
        concurrency: 2                                # 병렬 처리 수
        timeout-ms: 30000
    payment:
      consumer:
        processing-group: "payment-processing-group"  # 결제 처리 그룹
        retry-group: "payment-retry-group"            # 결제 재시도 그룹
      topics:
        processing: "payment-processing-topic"        # 결제 처리 토픽
        retry: "payment-retry-topic"                  # 결제 재시도 토픽
      retry:
        max-attempts: 3
        backoff-delay-ms: 1000
  elasticsearch:
    uris: http://elasticsearch:9200

  batch:
    jdbc:
      initialize-schema: never # 운영에선 직접 관리

  # OAuth2 설정 추가
  security:
    oauth2:
      client:
        registration:
          google:
            client-id: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}
            client-secret: <REDACTED>
            redirect-uri: https://www.pinjun.xyz/api/login/oauth2/code/google
            scope:
              - email
              - profile
          naver:
            client-id: ${NAVER_CLIENT_ID}
            client-secret: <REDACTED>
            redirect-uri: https://www.pinjun.xyz/api/login/oauth2/code/naver
            authorization-grant-type: authorization_code
            scope:
              - name
              - email
              - profile_image
            client-name: Naver
          kakao:
            client-id: ${KAKAO_CLIENT_ID}
            client-secret: <REDACTED>
            redirect-uri: https://www.pinjun.xyz/api/login/oauth2/code/kakao
            authorization-grant-type: authorization_code
            scope:
              - profile_nickname
              - profile_image
              - account_email
            client-name: Kakao
            client-authentication-method: client_secret_post
        provider:
          naver:
            authorization-uri: https://nid.naver.com/oauth2.0/authorize
            token-uri: <REDACTED>
            user-info-uri: https://openapi.naver.com/v1/nid/me
            user-name-attribute: response
          kakao:
            authorization-uri: https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/authorize
            token-uri: <REDACTED>
            user-info-uri: https://kapi.kakao.com/v2/user/me
            user-name-attribute: id

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,info,metrics
  endpoint:
    health:
      show-details: when-authorized
kibana:
  url: https://www.pinjun.xyz/kibana

logging:
  level:
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    org.springframework.security: DEBUG
    com.fream: INFO  # 프로젝트 패키지에 맞게 수정
    org.apache.kafka: INFO  # Kafka 로깅 레벨
  file:
    name: /logs/spring-app.log
  pattern:
    console: "%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n"
    file: "%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n"
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 10MB
      max-history: 30
      total-size-cap: 3GB

jwt:
  secret: <REDACTED>
  token-validity-in-seconds: <REDACTED>

imp:
  key: <REDACTED>
  secret: <REDACTED>
  pg: ${IMP_PG} # PG사와 가맹점 ID
  storeId: ${IMP_STOREID}

personal-data:
  encryption:
    secret-key: <REDACTED>
    iv: <REDACTED>

openai:
  api:
    key: <REDACTED>
    url: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
  model: gpt-3.5-turbo

server:
  use-forward-headers: true

# 결제 도메인 관련 설정 추가
payment:
  encryption:
    # 개발/테스트 환경용 하드코딩 암호화 키 (실제 운영 환경에서는 환경변수로 교체 필요)
    secret-key: <REDACTED>
    salt: "dev_payment_salt_value_for_testing_only"
    iv: <REDACTED>
  card-info:
    max-count: 5 # 사용자당 최대 등록 가능한 카드 정보 수
  retry:
    max-attempts: 3 # 결제 실패 시 최대 재시도 횟수
    delay-ms: 1000 # 재시도 간격 (밀리초)
  logging:
    mask-sensitive-data: <REDACTED>
  api:
    timeout: 10000 # 외부 API 호출 타임아웃 (밀리초)
  # Kafka 결제 처리 관련 설정
  kafka:
    enabled: true  # Kafka 결제 처리 활성화 여부
    topics:
      processing: "payment-processing-topic"
      retry: "payment-retry-topic"
    consumer:
      processing-group: "payment-processing-group"
      retry-group: "payment-retry-group"
      concurrency: 1  # 동시 처리 수 (결제는 순차 처리 권장)
    producer:
      timeout-ms: 5000
    retry:
      max-attempts: 3
      backoff-multiplier: 2
      initial-delay-ms: 1000

# weather 도메인 설정
weather:
  api:
    url: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast
    params:
      latitude: 36.5
      longitude: 127.75
      hourly: temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,precipitation,rain,snowfall
      timezone: auto
  scheduler:
    # 24시간(86400000 밀리초) 간격으로 갱신
    interval: 86400000
    # 초기 지연 시간 (서버 시작 후 10초 대기)
    initial-delay: 10000
  data:
    # 한 번에 처리할 시간 개수 (48시간)
    hours-count: 48

# AccessLog 도메인 설정
access-log:
  use-kafka: false  # false로 설정하여 직접 DB에 저장
  geoip:
    database-path: classpath:GeoLite2-City.mmdb
  kafka:
    topic: user-access-log-topic
    group-id: user-access-log-group

        <encoder>

	annotationProcessor "jakarta.annotation:jakarta.annotation-api"
	annotationProcessor "jakarta.persistence:jakarta.persistence-api"

//

configurations {

tasks.withType(JavaCompile) {

version: '3.8'
services:
  redis:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/redis/Dockerfile-redis
    container_name: redis_prod
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.4.0
    container_name: zookeeper
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"

  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0
    container_name: kafka
    depends_on:
      - zookeeper
    environment:
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      # 로컬에서 9095 포트로 접근
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:9095
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://0.0.0.0:9095
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
    ports:
      - "9095:9095"
      - "9092:9092"

  elasticsearch:
    build:
      context: ../../
      dockerfile: docker/elasticsearch/Dockerfile-elasticsearch
    container_name: elasticsearch
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
    volumes:
      - es_data_dev:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data
      - ./es_logs:/usr/share/elasticsearch/logs
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
      - "9300:9300"

  kibana:
    image: docker.elastic.co/kibana/kibana:8.10.2
    container_name: kibana
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
    environment:
      - ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS=http://elasticsearch:9200
    ports:
      - "5601:5601"

  nginx:
    build:
      context: ../../
      dockerfile: docker/nginx/Dockerfile-nginx
    image: custom-nginx:1.0
    container_name: nginx_server
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"

volumes:
  es_data_dev:

version: '3.8'
services:
  mysql:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/mysql/Dockerfile-mysql
    container_name: mysql_prod
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: <R>

    ports:

#  redis:

#    environment:

    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/redis/Dockerfile-redis-primary
    container_name: redis_primary_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\redis_primary_data:/data

  redis-replica:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/redis/Dockerfile-redis-replica
    container_name: redis_replica_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    ports:
      - "6380:6379"
    depends_on:
      - redis-primary
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\redis_replica_data:/data

  zookeeper:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/kafka/Dockerfile-zookeeper
    container_name: zookeeper_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"

  kafka:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/kafka/Dockerfile-kafka
    container_name: kafka_prod
    depends_on:
      - zookeeper
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper_prod:2181
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
      #      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka_prod:9092
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092
      KAFKA_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:9092
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"

  elasticsearch:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/elasticsearch/Dockerfile-elasticsearch
    container_name: es_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: 'false'
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\es_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\es_logs:/usr/share/elasticsearch/logs
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
      - "9300:9300"

  kibana:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/elasticsearch/Dockerfile-kibana
    container_name: kibana_prod
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS: http://elasticsearch:9200
      SERVER_BASEPATH: /kibana
      SERVER_REWRITEBASEPATH: true
    ports:
      - "5601:5601"

  nginx:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/prod/nginx/Dockerfile-nginx-prod
    container_name: nginx_prod
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    depends_on:
      - mysql
      - redis
      - kafka
      - elasticsearch
      - front
      - app
      - certbot
      - stt_tts
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\letsencrypt_data:/etc/letsencrypt
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\certbot_www:/var/www/certbot
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\fream-back\docker\prod\nginx\certs\localhost.pem:/etc/ssl/certs/localhost.pem:ro
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\fream-back\docker\prod\nginx\certs\localhost-key.pem:/etc/ssl/private/localhost-key.pem:ro


  app:
    build:
      context: ../..  # fream-back 루트 폴더
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile  # context 기준에서 docker/Dockerfile
    container_name: spring_boot_app_prod
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: prod
    env_file:
      - .env
#    depends_on:
#      - mysql
#      - redis
#      - kafka
#      - elasticsearch
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\fream:/home/ubuntu/fream
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\springlog:/logs

  front:
    build:
      context: ../../../fream-front  # C:\Users\pickj\webserver\fream-back\docker\prod로부터 C:\Users\pickj\webserver\fream-front
      dockerfile: Dockerfile  # 실제 Dockerfile 경로
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    container_name: fream_front_prod
    depends_on:
      - app  # optional

  # STT/TTS 서비스 추가
  stt_tts:
    build:
      context: ../../../fream-stt-tts  # 상대 경로로 stt-tts 프로젝트 폴더 지정
      dockerfile: Dockerfile  # fream-stt-tts 폴더 내의 Dockerfile
    container_name: stt_tts_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
      FLASK_APP: app.py
      FLASK_ENV: production
      DEBUG: false
      TEMP_FILES_LIFETIME: 3600
    env_file:
      - .env  # OpenAI API 키 등 환경변수
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\stt_tts_temp:/app/temp
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\stt_tts_models:/app/models
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\stt_tts_logs:/app/logs
    restart: unless-stopped
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 6G
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:5000/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s

  # certbot (선택)
  certbot:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/prod/nginx/certbot/Dockerfile-certbot
    container_name: certbot_prod
    environment:
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    volumes:
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\letsencrypt_data:/etc/letsencrypt
      - C:\Users\pickj\webserver\dockerVolums\certbot_www:/var/www/certbot
    entrypoint: >
      sh -c "trap exit TERM;
      certbot certonly --webroot --webroot-path=/var/www/certbot
      -d www.pinjun.xyz --email pickjog@naver.com --agree-tos --no-eff-email --force-renewal;
      while :; do sleep 12h; certbot renew -q; done"

  cache-cleaner:
    image: alpine:latest
    container_name: cache_cleaner_prod
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
      - redis
    volumes:
      - ./scripts:/scripts
    command: >
      sh -c "
      echo '0 2 * * * sh /scripts/clear_caches.sh' > /etc/crontabs/root &&
      crond -f
      "

  metricbeat:
    image: docker.elastic.co/beats/metricbeat:8.13.4
    container_name: metricbeat_prod
    user: root
    volumes:
      - /proc:/hostfs/proc:ro
      - /sys/fs/cgroup:/hostfs/sys/fs/cgroup:ro
      - /:/hostfs:ro
      - ./metricbeat.yml:/usr/share/metricbeat/metricbeat.yml:ro
    environment:
      - ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS=http://elasticsearch:9200
      - TZ=Asia/Seoul
    command: -e -system.hostfs=/hostfs
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
      - kibana
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 150M

# event 도메인 네비게이션 맵

> 기준 경로: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/event` (35 files). 모든 내용은 코드에서 확인된 사실만 기재.

## 1. 개요
- 브랜드(product 도메인 `Brand`)에 연결된 **프로모션 이벤트** CRUD + 썸네일/본문 이미지(SimpleImage) 파일 관리.
- 이벤트 상태(`UPCOMING/ACTIVE/ENDED`)는 **DB 컬럼이 아니라 startDate/endDate로 매번 계산**됨 (`Event.getStatus()`).
- Command/Query 컨트롤러·서비스 분리 패턴. 관리자 체크는 컨트롤러에서 `UserQueryService.checkAdminRole(email)`로 수행.
- `aop/` 패키지에 5개 Aspect + 5개 커스텀 어노테이션이 있으나 **어디에도 어노테이션이 붙어있지 않아 현재 동작하지 않음**(아래 7절).

## 2. 패키지/파일 구조
```
src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/event/
├── aop/
│   ├── EventBusinessRuleAspect.java     (@Order(5))
│   ├── EventCachingAspect.java          (@Order(4))
│   ├── EventFileManagementAspect.java   (@Order(2))
│   ├── EventMonitoringAspect.java       (@Order(3))
│   ├── EventValidationAspect.java       (@Order(1))
│   └── annotation/ EventBusinessRule, EventCaching, EventFileManagement, EventMonitoring, EventValidation
├── controller/
│   ├── command/EventCommandController.java
│   └── query/EventQueryController.java
├── dto/ CreateEventRequest, UpdateEventRequest, EventDetailDto, EventListDto, EventSearchCondition
├── entity/ Event, EventStatus, SimpleImage
├── exception/ EventErrorCode, EventException, EventNotFoundException, ImageNotFoundException, InvalidEventDateException
├── repository/ EventRepository, EventRepositoryCustom, EventRepositoryImpl (QueryDSL), EventSearchRepository (미사용), SimpleImageRepository
├── scheduler/EventStatusScheduler.java
└── service/
    ├── command/ EventCommandService, SimpleImageCommandService
    └── query/   EventQueryService, SimpleImageQueryService
```
공용: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/utils/FileUtils.java` (파일 저장/삭제/URL).

## 3. 엔티티
### `Event` (extends `global.entity.BaseTimeEntity` → createdDate/modifiedDate)
| 필드 | 비고 |
|---|---|
| `id` Long | IDENTITY |
| `title` String | not null |
| `description` String | `@Lob`, not null |
| `startDate`, `endDate` LocalDateTime | not null |
| `thumbnailFileName` String | 파일명만 저장 (생성 시 `""`로 초기화 후 갱신) |
| `simpleImages` List<SimpleImage> | `@OneToMany(mappedBy="event", cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval=true)` |
| `brand` Brand | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)`, `brand_id` → `domain.product.entity.Brand` |
| `status` EventStatus | `@Transient` (Event.java:53). `getStatus()`(L101)가 날짜로 계산해 반환 |

- 메서드: `addSimpleImage`, `updateThumbnailFileName`, `updateEvent(title, description, start, end)`(null이면 유지), `isActive()`(start < now < end), `isUpcoming()`(start > now), `isEnded()`(end <= now), `getStatus()`, `getStatusDisplayName()`.
### `SimpleImage`
- `id`, `savedFileName`(not null), `event`(`@ManyToOne(LAZY)`, `event_id`). `assignEvent(Event)`.
### `EventStatus` enum
- `UPCOMING("예정")`, `ACTIVE("진행 중")`, `ENDED("종료")` — `getDisplayName()`.

## 4. API 엔드포인트 (`@RequestMapping("/events")`)
관리자 체크 방식: `SecurityUtils.extractEmailFromSecurityContext()` → `UserQueryService.checkAdminRole(email)` (User.role != `Role.ADMIN`이면 `UserException(INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS)`). SecurityConfig는 whitelist 외 `anyRequest().authenticated()`이므로 GET 포함 모든 `/events/**` 요청은 인증 필요(`global/config/security/SecurityConfig.java:51-52`, whitelist에 events 없음).

| Method | Path | Controller#method | Service#method | 권한 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/events` (multipart: `@ModelAttribute CreateEventRequest` + `thumbnailFile` + `simpleImageFiles`) | `EventCommandController#createEvent` | `EventCommandService#createEvent` | ADMIN |
| PATCH | `/events/{eventId}` (+`thumbnailFile`, `simpleImageFiles`, `keepImageFileNames`) | `#updateEvent` | `EventCommandService#updateEvent` | ADMIN |
| DELETE | `/events/{eventId}` | `#deleteEvent` | `EventCommandService#deleteEvent` | ADMIN |
| PATCH | `/events/{eventId}/status?status=` | `#updateEventStatus` | `EventCommandService#updateEventStatus` | ADMIN |
| GET | `/events/page` (기본 size10, sort id DESC) | `EventQueryController#getAllEventsPaging` | `EventQueryService#findAllEventsWithPaging` | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/search?keyword&brandId&isActive&status&startDate&endDate` | `#searchEvents` | `EventQueryService#searchEvents` → `EventRepositoryImpl#searchEvents` | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/active` (sort startDate DESC) | `#getActiveEvents` | `#findActiveEventsWithPaging` | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/status/{status}` | `#getEventsByStatus` | `#findEventsByStatus` | 인증 |
| GET | `/events` | `#getAllEvents` | `#findAllEvents` | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/brands/{brandId}` | `#getEventsByBrand` | `#findEventsByBrandId` (@Cacheable) | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/{eventId}` | `#getEventDetail` | `#findEventById` (@Cacheable) | 인증 |
| GET | `/events/{eventId}/images/{fileName}` | `#getEventImage` | (서비스 없음) `FileUtils.existsFile` + `FileSystemResource` 직접 반환, 확장자로 Content-Type 결정(jpg/jpeg/png/gif, 그 외 octet-stream) | 인증 |

## 5. 서비스 계층
- **`EventCommandService`** (`@Transactional`)
  - `createEvent(req, thumbnail, simpleImages)`: `validateEventDates` → `BrandQueryService.findById` (실패 시 `product.exception.BrandNotFoundException`) → Event 저장 → 썸네일 `fileUtils.saveFile("event/{id}", "thumbnail_{id}_", file)` → `SimpleImageCommandService.createSimpleImages`. 기타 Exception은 `RuntimeException`으로 래핑.
  - `updateEvent(id, req, thumbnail, newImages, keepImageFileNames)`: 날짜 검증 → 필드 갱신 → `handleSimpleImagesUpdate`(keep 목록에 없는 기존 이미지 파일+엔티티 삭제, 새 이미지 추가) → `handleThumbnailUpdate`(기존 썸네일 파일 삭제 후 새로 저장).
  - `updateEventStatus(id, newStatus)`: 상태가 계산값이므로 **날짜를 덮어써서** 상태를 맞춤 — UPCOMING: start=now+1d, end=start+7d / ACTIVE: start=now-1d, end=now+7d / ENDED: start=now-14d, end=now-1d.
  - `deleteEvent(id)`: 썸네일·SimpleImage 파일 삭제 후 `eventRepository.delete`(cascade로 SimpleImage row 삭제).
  - `validateEventDates`: null 금지, start ≤ end, 기간 최소 1시간 → `InvalidEventDateException`.
- **`SimpleImageCommandService`**: `createSimpleImages(event, files)`(prefix `simple_{eventId}_{순번}_`, 빈 파일 skip), `deleteAllByEvent(eventId)`, `deleteSimpleImage(imageId)`.
- **`EventQueryService`** (`readOnly`): `findEventById`(`@Cacheable("eventDetails", key=#eventId)`), `findActiveEvents`(`@Cacheable("activeEvents")`, 컨트롤러 미사용), `findEventsByBrandId`(`@Cacheable("brandEvents", key=#brandId)`), `searchEvents`, `findEventsByStatus`, `findAllEventsWithPaging`, `findActiveEventsWithPaging`, `findAllEvents`. DTO 변환 시 URL은 `fileUtils.getFileUrl("event/{id}", fileName)`.
- **`SimpleImageQueryService`**: `findByEventId`, `findById`(`ImageNotFoundException`).

## 6. Repositories
- `EventRepository extends JpaRepository<Event,Long>, EventRepositoryCustom`
  - 파생 쿼리: `findByBrandIdOrderByStartDateDesc`, `findByStartDateBeforeAndEndDateAfter`(스케줄러), `findByEndDateLessThanEqual`(스케줄러), `findByStartDateAfterOrderByStartDateAsc`, `findByEndDateBeforeOrderByEndDateDesc`.
  - `@Query`: `findActiveEvents(now)`, `findAllWithBrand`(JOIN FETCH), `findAllWithBrandPaging`, `findByIdWithBrand`, `findActiveEventsWithBrandPaging`, `findByBrandIdWithBrand`, `findByBrandIdWithBrandPaging`, `findByIdWithBrandAndSimpleImages`.
- `EventRepositoryImpl#searchEvents` (QueryDSL, `JPAQueryFactory`): brand fetchJoin, 조건 = title containsIgnoreCase / brand.id eq / isActive(날짜 비교) / startDate goe / endDate loe / status(날짜 조건으로 변환). 정렬 없으면 id DESC. `PageableExecutionUtils.getPage`.
- `EventSearchRepository`: 동일 기능의 구버전 QueryDSL 클래스 — **어디서도 참조되지 않음**(grep 확인).
- `SimpleImageRepository`: `@Query findByEventId`, `@Query("DELETE ...") deleteByEventId` — **`@Modifying` 없음**(SimpleImageRepository.java:12-13).

## 7. 외부 연동 / 비동기 / 파일
### 파일 저장 (`global/utils/FileUtils.java`)
- `BASE_DIR = "/home/ubuntu/fream"` (하드코딩, Windows 경로는 주석). 이벤트 디렉토리: `/home/ubuntu/fream/event/{eventId}/`.
- `saveFile(dir, prefix, file)`: Content-Type이 `image/*` 또는 `video/*`가 아니면 `UnsupportedFileTypeException`; 파일명 = `prefix + UUID + 원본확장자`; 반환값(파일명)만 DB 저장.
- `deleteFile`, `existsFile`, `deleteDirectory`, `isFileExist`, `saveMediaFile`(=saveFile).
- `getFileUrl(dir, name)` → `"/api/files/{dir}/{name}"`. **이 코드베이스에 `/files/**` 범용 컨트롤러는 없음**(grep 확인) → 실제 이미지 서빙은 `GET /events/{eventId}/images/{fileName}`.
- `EventQueryController`에도 `BASE_DIR`이 별도로 하드코딩됨(EventQueryController.java:35) — 경로 변경 시 FileUtils와 함께 수정.
- 이벤트 description은 HTML img src 재작성 로직 없음(FAQ/Notice/Inspection과 다름).

### 스케줄러 `EventStatusScheduler`
- `@Scheduled(cron = "0 0 * * * *")`(매시 정각) + `@Transactional` `checkEventStatus()`. 클래스에 `@EnableScheduling`.
- `findByStartDateBeforeAndEndDateAfter(now,now)` / `findByEndDateLessThanEqual(now)` 조회 후 **로그만 남김**(상태가 계산값이라 DB 변경 없음, 알림 없음).

### 캐싱
- `global/config/CacheConfig.java`: `ConcurrentMapCacheManager`에 `setCacheNames(faq*, inspection*)`만 등록. **`eventDetails`, `activeEvents`, `brandEvents`는 목록에 없음** → 고정 캐시 이름 모드에서는 미등록 캐시 사용 시 Spring이 "Cannot find cache named" 예외를 던지므로 `GET /events/{id}`, `/events/brands/{id}` 동작에 주의.
- event 측에 `@CacheEvict` 없음 → 수정/삭제 후에도 캐시 무효화 안 됨.

### AOP (`domain/event/aop`) — 전부 `@Around("@annotation(x)")` 기반, **현재 어노테이션 사용처 0건**
| Aspect | Order | 포인트컷 | 하는 일(코드 기준) | 주입 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EventValidationAspect` | 1 | `@annotation(eventValidation)` | `@EventValidation.validations()`별 검증: DATE_RANGE(min 시간/max 일수/과거일), BUSINESS_RULE, BRAND_VALIDATION, FILE_VALIDATION(확장자/총용량), STATUS_VALIDATION, PERMISSION_CHECK(admin), DUPLICATE_CHECK, CAPACITY_CHECK; 실패 시 `failureAction` | EventRepository, BrandQueryService |
| `EventFileManagementAspect` | 2 | `@annotation(fileManagement)` | MultipartFile 검증(확장자/크기/개수), 리사이즈, WebP 변환·바이러스 스캔·백업(스텁), 실패 시 롤백, 메트릭 | FileUtils |
| `EventMonitoringAspect` | 3 | `@annotation(eventMonitoring)` | 실행시간/메모리/CPU, 사용자 활동, 라이프사이클, 브랜드 통계, 임계치 알림. `sendStatusChangeNotification`은 로그만 출력(L539) | — (인메모리 Map, ScheduledExecutor) |
| `EventCachingAspect` | 4 | `@annotation(eventCaching)` | `CacheManager` 기반 키 전략별 캐싱, TTL, 웜업, 무효화(`invalidateCacheOnStatusChange`, `invalidateBrandCache`, `clearAllCaches`) | CacheManager |
| `EventBusinessRuleAspect` | 5 | `@annotation(businessRule)` | 이벤트 중복 기간, 브랜드당 활성 이벤트 수(기본 5), 생성 쿨다운, 수정/삭제 가능 시점, 아카이빙(인메모리 리스트) 등 | EventRepository, BrandQueryService |
- 어노테이션 정의: `aop/annotation/*.java` (`@Target(METHOD, TYPE)`, RUNTIME). 적용하려면 서비스 메서드에 어노테이션을 붙여야 하며, 붙이는 순간 위 로직이 활성화됨.

## 8. 다른 도메인 의존
- `domain.product`: `entity.Brand`(ManyToOne), `service.brand.BrandQueryService#findById`, `exception.BrandNotFoundException`.
- `domain.user`: `service.query.UserQueryService#checkAdminRole` (컨트롤러).
- `global`: `BaseTimeEntity`, `FileUtils`, `SecurityUtils`, `GlobalException`/`ErrorCode`, `CacheConfig`.
- 역방향: 다른 도메인에서 event 참조는 `global/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java`(`@ExceptionHandler(EventException.class)`, L390)뿐.

## 9. 예외
- `EventException extends GlobalException`; `EventErrorCode implements ErrorCode`, prefix **`EVENT-`**:
  EVENT-001 EVENT_NOT_FOUND(404), 002 INVALID_EVENT_DATE(400), 003 INVALID_EVENT_DATA(400), 004 EVENT_TITLE_DUPLICATE(409), 005 EVENT_MODIFICATION_DENIED(403), 006 EVENT_DELETION_DENIED(403), 007 IMAGE_NOT_FOUND(404), 008 IMAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED(500), 009 INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT(400), 010 BRAND_NOT_FOUND(404).
- 하위: `EventNotFoundException`, `ImageNotFoundException`, `InvalidEventDateException`.
- 서비스 내부 catch-all이 많아 `RuntimeException("...중 오류 발생")`으로 래핑되는 경로 존재(createEvent, 이미지 처리, deleteEvent).

## 10. 작업 팁 / 주의점
- 상태 필터링을 추가할 때는 컬럼이 아니라 **날짜 조건**으로 작성(`EventRepositoryImpl#statusEquals` 참고).
- `PATCH /events/{id}`에서 `keepImageFileNames`를 안 보내면 **기존 SimpleImage 전부 삭제**됨(null → 빈 리스트 처리).
- `UpdateEventRequest`의 title/description/startDate/endDate는 `@NotBlank/@NotNull` → 부분 수정 불가(전 필드 필요). `UpdateEventRequest.keepImageFileNames` 필드와 `@RequestParam keepImageFileNames`가 중복 존재; 서비스는 RequestParam 값을 사용.
- `PATCH /{id}/status`는 이벤트 날짜를 **덮어씀**(원래 기간 소실).
- `SimpleImageRepository.deleteByEventId`는 `@Modifying` 누락 → 호출 시 실패 가능(현재 `SimpleImageCommandService#deleteAllByEvent`에서만 사용, 컨트롤러 경로에선 미호출).
- 파일 디렉토리 규칙 `event/{eventId}` 문자열이 서비스/컨트롤러 여러 곳에 하드코딩.
- Event 캐시 미등록/미무효화 문제(7절) 참고.
- `EventSearchRepository`는 dead code; 검색 수정은 `EventRepositoryImpl`에서.

# notification 도메인 네비게이션

## 1. 개요
- 사용자 대상 알림(쇼핑/스타일)을 DB(`Notification`)에 저장하고, WebSocket(STOMP, `/user/{email}/queue/notifications`)으로 실시간 푸시.
- 실시간 푸시는 Redis 키 `WebSocket:User:{email}` 존재 시에만 시도(연결된 사용자 판단). 푸시 실패해도 저장은 유지.
- 알림 생성은 주로 **다른 도메인 서비스가 `NotificationCommandService`를 직접 호출**하는 방식(Kafka 경유 아님). REST로도 생성 가능(관리자 체크 미구현).
- CQRS 분리: `controller/command`, `controller/query`, `service/command`, `service/query`.

## 2. 패키지/파일 구조 (14 files)
```
src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/notification/
├── controller/command/NotificationCommandController.java   # POST/PATCH/DELETE /notifications, STOMP @MessageMapping("/ping")
├── controller/query/NotificationQueryController.java       # GET /notifications/...
├── dto/NotificationDTO.java            # id, category, type, message, isRead, createdAt(String)
├── dto/NotificationRequestDTO.java     # category(@NotNull), type(@NotNull), message(@NotBlank, 1~500자)
├── entity/Notification.java
├── entity/NotificationCategory.java
├── entity/NotificationType.java
├── exception/NotificationErrorCode.java
├── exception/NotificationException.java   # extends GlobalException
├── repository/NotificationRepository.java            # JpaRepository + NotificationRepositoryCustom
├── repository/NotificationRepositoryCustom.java
├── repository/NotificationRepositoryCustomImpl.java  # QueryDSL
├── service/command/NotificationCommandService.java   # 생성/읽음/삭제/실시간 전송/Redis TTL
└── service/query/NotificationQueryService.java       # 필터 조회, 미읽음 카운트
```
관련 글로벌 파일:
- `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/websocket/WebSocketConfig.java`
- `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/websocket/WebSocketAuthInterceptor.java`
- `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/EmailBasedUserDestinationResolver.java`
- `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/security/SecurityConfig.java` (`/ws/**` whitelist)

## 3. 엔티티
### `Notification` (extends `BaseTimeEntity` → `createdDate` 사용)
| 필드 | 타입 | 비고 |
|---|---|---|
| id | Long | IDENTITY |
| category | `NotificationCategory` | `@Enumerated(STRING)` |
| type | `NotificationType` | `@Enumerated(STRING)` |
| message | String | |
| isRead | boolean | `@Builder.Default false` |
| user | `User` (user 도메인) | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)`, `user_id` NOT NULL |
- 메서드: `markAsRead()`, `markAsUnread()`.

### Enums
- `NotificationCategory`: `SHOPPING`("쇼핑 관련 알림"), `STYLE`("스타일 관련 알림").
- `NotificationType` (category 소속 포함):
  - SHOPPING: `TRADE`, `BID`, `STORAGE`, `FAVORITE`, `BENEFIT`, `ANNOUNCEMENT`, `REFUND`
  - STYLE: `LIKE`, `COMMENT`, `FOLLOW`
  - `static getTypesByCategory(category)` (null이면 전체).
- 주의: type의 category와 엔티티 category 일치 여부를 검증하는 코드는 없음(호출자가 각각 지정).

## 4. API 엔드포인트
모든 경로는 `SecurityConfig` whitelist에 없으므로 `anyRequest().authenticated()` 적용(인증 필요). 이메일은 `SecurityContextHolder` principal(String)에서 추출 — 컨트롤러 내부 private `extractEmailFromSecurityContext()`; 없으면 `NOTIFICATION_USER_NOT_FOUND`(N011).

| Method | Path | Controller#method | Service#method | 비고 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/notifications?userId={id}` (body `NotificationRequestDTO`) | `NotificationCommandController#createNotification` | `NotificationCommandService#createNotification(userId, category, type, message)` | 201. 관리자 체크 "미구현" 주석(L53) |
| POST | `/notifications/broadcast` | `NotificationCommandController#createNotificationForAll` | `NotificationCommandService#createNotificationForAll(dto)` | 201. 관리자 체크 미구현(L76) |
| PATCH | `/notifications/{id}/read` | `NotificationCommandController#markAsRead` | `NotificationCommandService#markAsRead(id, email)` | 소유자 검증 있음(N012) |
| PATCH | `/notifications/read-all` | `NotificationCommandController#markAllAsRead` | `NotificationCommandService#markAllAsRead(email)` | |
| DELETE | `/notifications/{id}` | `NotificationCommandController#deleteNotification` | `NotificationCommandService#deleteNotification(id)` | 204. **소유자 검증 없음** (email 추출만, 서비스에 전달 안 함) |
| DELETE | `/notifications/user` | `NotificationCommandController#deleteAllUserNotifications` | `NotificationCommandService#deleteNotificationsByUser(email)` | 204 |
| GET | `/notifications/filter/category?category=` | `NotificationQueryController#filterByCategory` | `NotificationQueryService#filterByCategory` | List, 최신순 |
| GET | `/notifications/filter/type?type=` | `NotificationQueryController#filterByType` | `NotificationQueryService#filterByType` | List, 최신순 |
| GET | `/notifications/filter/category/read-status?category=&isRead=&page=0&size=10&sort=createdDate,desc` | `NotificationQueryController#filterByCategoryAndIsRead` | `NotificationQueryService#filterByCategoryAndIsRead` | category optional. 페이징이지만 응답은 `List`(Page 메타 없음) |
| GET | `/notifications/filter/type/read-status?type=&isRead=&page=&size=&sort=` | `NotificationQueryController#filterByTypeAndIsRead` | `NotificationQueryService#filterByTypeAndIsRead` | type optional. 응답 `List` |
| GET | `/notifications/count/unread` | `NotificationQueryController#countUnreadNotifications` | `NotificationQueryService#countUnreadNotifications` | `{"count": n}` |
| STOMP SEND | `/app/ping` | `NotificationCommandController#handlePing` (`@MessageMapping("/ping")`) | `NotificationCommandService#updateWebSocketConnectionTTL(email)` | Redis TTL 갱신 |

- 페이징 검증: `page < 0` 또는 `size <= 0 || size > 100` → `NotificationException(GlobalErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT_VALUE)` (`NotificationQueryController#validatePaginationParams`).
- sort 문자열은 `"field,dir"` 파싱 → Repository `getOrderSpecifiers`가 `createdDate|category|type|isRead`만 인식, 그 외는 createdDate DESC.

## 5. 서비스 계층
### `NotificationCommandService` (`@Transactional`)
의존: `NotificationRepository`, `UserRepository`(user 도메인), `SimpMessagingTemplate`, `RedisTemplate<String,String>`.
상수: `REDIS_KEY_PREFIX="WebSocket:User:"`, `WEBSOCKET_DESTINATION="/queue/notifications"`, `REDIS_TTL_MINUTES=30` (L37-39).
| 메서드 | 동작 |
|---|---|
| `createNotification(Long userId, category, type, message)` L44 | `userRepository.findById` → save → `sendRealTimeNotification(email, dto)` → DTO 반환. 실패 시 N011/N001 |
| `createNotificationForAll(NotificationRequestDTO)` L72 | `userRepository.findAll()` → 사용자별 Notification `saveAll` → `broadcastNotificationsToConnectedUsers` |
| `markAsRead(id, email)` L104 | 소유자 이메일 불일치 시 N012. dirty checking |
| `markAllAsRead(email)` L140 | `findAllByUserEmail` 후 루프 markAsRead |
| `deleteNotification(id)` L168 | `existsById` → `deleteById` (소유자 검증 없음) |
| `deleteNotificationsByUser(email)` L196 | `findAllByUserEmail` → `deleteAll` |
| `notifyShipmentCompleted(Order)` L219 | 구매자에게 `SHOPPING/BID` "[배송 완료] ..." 생성. 예외는 로깅만(전파 안 함) |
| `updateWebSocketConnectionTTL(email)` L328 | 남은 TTL ≤ 600초일 때만 30분으로 `expire` (키가 없으면 getExpire 결과 음수 → expire 호출되지만 키 없으므로 무효) |
| private `sendRealTimeNotification` L303 | Redis 키 존재 시 `convertAndSendToUser(email, "/queue/notifications", NotificationDTO)` |
| private `broadcastNotificationsToConnectedUsers` L269 | 연결 사용자마다 **`List<NotificationDTO>`** 를 전송 (단건 전송과 payload 형태가 다름) |

### `NotificationQueryService` (`@Transactional(readOnly = true)`)
- `filterByCategory(email, category)` — category null이면 N021.
- `filterByType(email, type)` — type null이면 N020.
- `filterByCategoryAndIsRead(email, category, isRead, pageable)`, `filterByTypeAndIsRead(...)` — Page → List 변환.
- `countUnreadNotifications(email)` — `findByUserEmailAndIsRead(email,false,Pageable.unpaged())`의 `getTotalElements()`.

## 6. Repository (QueryDSL: `NotificationRepositoryCustomImpl`)
모든 쿼리는 `notification.user` fetch join + `user.email = :email` 조건(동적 `BooleanExpression`, null이면 조건 생략).
- `findByUserEmailAndCategory(email, category)` — createdDate DESC
- `findByUserEmailAndType(email, type)` — createdDate DESC
- `findByUserEmailAndIsRead(email, isRead, pageable)` — Page, count 쿼리 별도
- `findByUserEmailAndCategoryAndIsRead(email, category, isRead, pageable)` — category null이면 필터 생략
- `findByUserEmailAndTypeAndIsRead(email, type, isRead, pageable)` — type null이면 필터 생략
- `findAllByUserEmail(email)` — createdDate DESC
- `@Query` 없음.

## 7. 외부 연동 / WebSocket
### STOMP 설정 (`global/config/websocket/WebSocketConfig.java`)
- `@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker`, SimpleBroker: `/topic`, `/queue` (L28)
- Application prefix: `/app` (L29), User prefix: `/user` (L30)
- Endpoint: `/ws`, `setAllowedOrigins("https://www.pinjun.xyz")`, `.withSockJS()`, HandshakeInterceptor = `new WebSocketAuthInterceptor(...)` (L35-38)
- `SecurityConfig` whitelist에 `/ws/**` 포함(HTTP 레벨 permitAll) → 인증은 인터셉터가 담당.

### 인증 (`WebSocketAuthInterceptor`, HandshakeInterceptor)
- `beforeHandshake` (L51): 쿠키 `ACCESS_TOKEN` 추출 → `jwtTokenProvider.validateToken` → `getEmailFromToken` → `userRepository.findByEmail` 존재 확인 → handshake `attributes.put("email", email)`. 어떤 예외든 `false` 반환(핸드셰이크 거부).
- `afterHandshake` (L111): **서블릿 request attribute `"attributes"`** 에서 Map을 읽어 `email`이 있으면 Redis `WebSocket:User:{email}` = `"CONNECTED"`, TTL 30분 설정(TTL null 또는 ≤600초일 때). beforeHandshake가 쓰는 handshake attributes 맵과는 다른 저장소이며, 코드베이스에 `setAttribute("attributes", ...)` 하는 곳은 grep상 없음 → 이 경로에서 Redis 키가 설정되지 않을 수 있음(실시간 전송 조건과 직결, 작업 시 확인 필요).
- 커스텀 `HandshakeHandler` / `ChannelInterceptor` 없음 → STOMP 세션 Principal은 Spring 기본 동작(HTTP 요청 Principal)에 의존. `convertAndSendToUser(email, ...)`는 그 Principal 이름이 email일 때 전달됨.

### 목적지(Destination)
| 목적지 | 송신자 | payload |
|---|---|---|
| `/user/{email}/queue/notifications` (`convertAndSendToUser(email, "/queue/notifications", ...)`) | `NotificationCommandService#sendRealTimeNotification` | `NotificationDTO` |
| 동일 | `NotificationCommandService#broadcastNotificationsToConnectedUsers` | `List<NotificationDTO>` |
| 동일 | `domain/order/service/kafka/OrderEventConsumer.java` L300, L347 (`sendSuccessNotification`, `sendFailureNotification`) | `Map` (orderId, status, type=ORDER_COMPLETED/ORDER_FAILED, title, message, timestamp...) — **DB 저장 없음**, Redis 연결 체크 없음 |
| `/topic/order/{orderId}` | `OrderEventConsumer` L304, L351 | 위와 동일 Map |
| `/app/ping` (client→server) | 클라이언트 | TTL 갱신 |

- `EmailBasedUserDestinationResolver#resolveUserDestination(dest)` → `"/user/" + email + dest` 반환. **코드베이스 어디에서도 사용되지 않음**(grep 기준).
- Kafka: notification 도메인 자체에는 Kafka producer/consumer 없음. 참고로 `OrderEventConsumer`가 `notification-topic`으로 발행(L318, L364)하지만 이를 소비하는 notification 코드는 없음.
- 스케줄러 없음.

### Redis 키
- `WebSocket:User:{email}` — 값 `"CONNECTED"`, TTL 30분. 설정: `WebSocketAuthInterceptor#afterHandshake`; 갱신: `NotificationCommandService#updateWebSocketConnectionTTL`; 조회: `sendRealTimeNotification`, `broadcastNotificationsToConnectedUsers` (`hasKey`).

## 알림 발송 흐름

### (2) 저장 + 푸시
1. `NotificationCommandService#createNotification` → `UserRepository.findById` → `Notification.builder()...isRead(false)` → `notificationRepository.save`.

1. SockJS `/ws` 연결(쿠키 `ACCESS_TOKEN` 필수) → `/user/queue/notifications` 구독.
2. 주기적으로 `/app/ping` SEND → Redis TTL 연장.
3. REST 조회: `GET /notifications/filter/...`, 배지: `GET /notifications/count/unread`.

## 8. 다른 도메인과의 의존
- notification → user: `User` 엔티티(ManyToOne), `UserRepository` (`findById`, `findAll`).

- `NotificationException extends GlobalException` (`ErrorCode` 아무거나 받음 — 컨트롤러에서 `GlobalErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT_VALUE`도 사용).
- `NotificationErrorCode` (접두사 `N`):

  | N020 | INVALID_NOTIFICATION_TYPE | 400 |

## 10. 작업 팁 / 주의점
- `NotificationCommandService` 클래스 레벨 `@Transactional` → 다른 도메인 트랜잭션에 참여. `createNotification` 예외는 래핑되어 전파됨(호출자가 catch 안 하면 상위 트랜잭션 rollback-only).
- `markAllAsRead` (L140)는 모든 알림을 로드해 루프 처리(벌크 update 아님). `deleteNotificationsByUser`도 엔티티 로드 후 `deleteAll`.

- WebSocket allowed origin은 `https://www.pinjun.xyz` 하드코딩(WebSocketConfig L36).
